snippet.title: OFFICIAL TRAILER - Ranger Commando
snippet.description:
Ranger Commando is a nostalgic '80s-inspired isometric tactical shooter. 

Explore randomly generated missions, assassinate officers, free hostages, blow stuff up. No handholding, but easy to pick up! 

Coming Q4 2025 - Wishlist now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2549980/RANGER_COMMANDO/

https://rangercommando.com 


Solo dev project, please be gentle 🙏
